steps.title: Tab and flange
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as lid_catch.ipt.
Sketch the L shape on the YZ Plane: a tab 3 thick, 41.5 long, and a flange 4 x 1.5 at the top. Extrude 19.5 mm.
steps.note: Heat staked to the inside of the lid top.

steps.title: Hook
actions: Sketch a 2 x 3.5 rectangle on the outside of the bottom of the tab. Extrude 19.5 mm, Join. Save.
steps.note: The cam of the lock lies on top of the hook.
